_comment: MANUAL install only - an Ansible deploy writes this file from the site vault's routeros_api_logins. Copy to secrets/routeros_api_credentials.json (gitignored) and fill in. Keyed by the router `name` from routeros_exporter/config.yml (POP routers only). Use a dedicated read-only RouterOS user: /user add name=prom-ro group=read password=... comment="routeros-exporter (read-only)"
